row:
Wondering what type of work you want to do? Watch these videos, learn about occupations and plan your future!

The Alis website is Alberta's online gateway to services and information related to career planning, education, jobs and the workplace. This online service is sponsored by  the Government of Alberta. 

The Alis website is located at https://alis.alberta.ca
